count_correction: the supplement was SEVEN constants in six clauses (marbled carried three); the preserving commit prose said six — corrected here
root_cause_mechanism: all seven misses are literals inside HELPER-CALL ARGUMENT EXPRESSIONS (detail=4.0, seed=spec[seed]+11, scale_mm=p[vein_scale_mm]*0.6). The original census enumerated node-input assignments, named-variable formulas and statement-level multipliers — it never walked call-argument expressions. A selection bias compounded it: where the same keyword was a FORMULA in one family (matte detail=3+3*var) it was censused, while plain-literal analogues elsewhere matched no pattern. The mechanism, not the instances: the scan's pattern set keyed on assignment shapes; call-argument expression trees were structurally invisible.
corrected_instrument: AST whole-expression walk of every family function plus reachable helpers; every numeric literal enumerated regardless of syntactic position; exemptions declared (arithmetic identities 0/1/0.5/2, numeric guards, the degree-radian MATH_CONSTANT); params reads collected with dotted paths
